new_findings.title: Reopen PO counts reversed FG outflows as active downstream use
new_findings.root_cause: sum(-qty_signed) over every historical negative movement omits cancellation/reversal pairing.

cases.disposition: Original auditor production-lot account oracle error retained; see qualified v2

new_findings.proved_impact: Legitimate correction remains blocked after cancelled sales reservation or reversed adjustment; no balance corruption claimed.
new_findings.required: Count active downstream use using correct reversal/source semantics; retain real-use and closed-period guards. Original two cases must pass; add partial cancellation and concurrency controls.

new_findings.title: Auto-PO numbering cannot carry from 999 to 1000
new_findings.root_cause: lpad(v_n::text,3,'0') truncates four-digit numbers into occupied three-digit prefixes inside the while loop.
new_findings.proved_impact: Posting stalls when daily numbering must exceed999; daily lock retained until cancellation. Savepoint rollback leaves stock8 and no partial request/history.
new_findings.frequency_boundary: Requires001..999 occupied for a single date; not an assertion about ordinary daily volume.
new_findings.required: Do not truncate digits; retain serial numbering/idempotency/atomic posting. Retest998,999,1000,1001 plus collisions, concurrent posts and same-UUID replay.
